summary: Re-verified full auth regression after localStorage→httpOnly cookie migration + regression pass on all previously-passing features. Backend: 22/22 pytest passed (added 3 new tests: cookie flags after login, /auth/logout clears cookie, Bearer fallback still works; fixed 2 pre-existing tests that shared a session and would now inherit the login cookie). Frontend Playwright E2E: cookies+localStorage cleared first, then verified — (1) unauth /admin → /admin/login redirect, (2) wrong password shows 'Usuário ou senha inválidos', (3) Deivid login works, access_token cookie set with httpOnly=true, secure=true, sameSite=None, and NO token in localStorage, (4) KPIs load, (5) session PERSISTS across reload (not bounced), (6) logout redirects to /admin/login and /auth/me returns 401 afterwards (console error confirms), (7) /admin protected again post-logout, (8) Bruno login works, (9) search filter, audit dialog, ticket list all functional. Admin Deivid chat sheet was not re-driven end-to-end via UI in this run (sheet-open selector timeout after 5s), but /api/chat scope=admin streaming was verified via pytest.

issues: Radix a11y warning still present: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Non-blocking; carried over from iteration 1.

action_items: (Optional/low) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to the audit-trail DialogContent and Deivid SheetContent to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth cookie config is correct: httpOnly=True, secure=True, samesite='lax', max_age=7d, path='/'. Browser reports sameSite='None' because Secure+cross-site iframe context; still same-site to the app domain and cookie IS sent → works.
get_current_admin correctly reads cookie 'access_token' first then falls back to Authorization: Bearer — verified both paths in tests.

/api/auth/logout uses response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/'). After logout, /auth/me returns 401 (verified). Note: Playwright's context.cookies() may still list the cookie briefly with empty value; behavior is correct.
Frontend api.js uses withCredentials:true globally; no token stored in localStorage (verified). AuthContext memoizes value and check() runs on mount → session restore works.
CORS: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins from env — good. Since frontend/backend are same-origin on preview, cookies flow without issue.
seed_admins is idempotent AND now re-hashes when env password changes — good.

Minor: previous backend tests used one shared requests.Session for negative auth checks; once a login runs in a parallel worker, the cookie sticks and negative tests can flip to 200. Fixed by using fresh Session in test_me_no_token and test_list_requires_auth.

rca of the issue: No functional issue. Only a test-side bug uncovered by the auth change: previously the shared requests.Session held no cookie, so /auth/me without headers naturally returned 401. After the cookie migration, once a login runs in the same session the cookie sticks and /auth/me returns 200. Fixed by isolating the 2 negative-auth tests to fresh Sessions.
